title: PAH-001 finite reversible dynamics and common-core compatibility audit

conditions.requirement: The displayed F_rho is exactly gauge invariant.
proof: Aperture and all absolute-value onsite terms are gauge neutral.
For e=(v,w), psi_w-U_e psi_v transforms to zeta_K^(g_w)(psi_w-U_e psi_v), so its squared modulus is unchanged.
The ordered closed plaquette product has telescoping vertex phases and U_p is unchanged in the abelian group Z_K; J_e and J_p depend only on neutral aperture variables.

conditions.requirement: The declared rates satisfy detailed balance for pi_(rho,Q).
proof: The declared inverse-pair mobility symmetry m_r(x)=m_(r^(-1))(y) gives the identical reverse expression pi(y)c_(r^(-1))(y).
epsilon>0, nu>0 and positive frozen rate scales make every displayed mobility and rate nonnegative; L_rho 1=0 follows termwise.

conditions.requirement: P_cand is idempotent and self-adjoint and commutes with L_rho.
proof: Gauge invariance of F_rho and relabelling invariance of the displayed uniform functional make the finite group actions unitary on L2(pi). Their group averages P_G and P_Aut are orthogonal projections.
Aut(G;O,C) normalizes Z_K^V, hence P_Aut commutes with P_G and their product is an orthogonal projection.
missing: The four move types are prose labels, not exact state maps with admissibility domains, root multiplicities and a declared action h:r->h r h^(-1).

The source states inverse-pair mobility symmetry but does not state or prove gauge/Aut equivariance m_(h r h^(-1))(h x)=m_r(x). Without that exact transition-kernel contract, [P_cand,L_rho]=0 is not a theorem of the displayed bytes.

conditions.requirement: On the finite invariant core, B^*B=-L_rho with the correct sign, factor, measure and domain.
proof: Conditionally, if the directed-root Hilbert space is L2({(x,r)}, pi(x) times counting roots), each directed move is counted once and B has the displayed sqrt(c_r/2) factor, detailed balance gives <Bf,Bg>=<f,-L_rho g> and therefore B^*B=-L_rho on the finite full function space and every invariant subspace preserved by L_rho.
The factor 1/2 exactly compensates the two directed orientations of each inverse-paired transition.
missing: The source never defines the directed-root Hilbert-space inner product or measure.

The source does not fix whether invalid boundary moves are omitted, represented by identity roots, or assigned zero rate, nor whether duplicate moves with the same state transition are distinct roots.
Therefore B^* and the claimed operator equality are not uniquely determined by PAH-001-v1.

conditions.requirement: A declared anchor-preserving refinement embedding preserves the same cylinder observable and generator structure.
missing: No named refinement sequence or map between two finite complexes is defined.
No configuration map, cylinder-observable embedding, parameter transport, move/root embedding or equation iota_(rho,rho') L_rho=L_(rho') iota_(rho,rho') is displayed.
The LATTICE_REFINEMENT topology is literally 'to be specified', and the source itself records refinement embeddings and generator agreement as unproved.

conditional_finite_theorem.scope: This theorem identifies the exact extra finite data that would close C3 and C4 without changing F_rho, nu or the move types.
hypotheses: Every prose move type is expanded into a finite inverse-paired set of exact partial bijections on Omega_(rho,Q), with invalid moves omitted or assigned one fixed declared convention.
Gauge and anchor-automorphism actions carry each root to an allowed root and preserve its mobility.
The root Hilbert space is L2 of directed roots with measure pi(x) times counting multiplicity, and every inverse-directed root is counted exactly once.
conditional_finite_theorem.conclusion: P_cand is an orthogonal projection commuting with L_rho and B^*B=-L_rho on the finite invariant function space.
conditional_finite_theorem.promotion_boundary: The hypotheses are not silently inserted into PAH-001-v1 and the conditional theorem does not close C3 or C4 for the immutable source.
